findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_property_assessment, get_owner_workspace, get_owner_review_details, review_veteran_requirements, generate_veteran_packet, start_tax_sandbox, get_tax_sandbox_order, complete_tax_sandbox_order · Private data: suggest_addresses, get_property_assessment, recheck_property_opportunities, get_va_facility, start_va_connection, disconnect_va_connection, review_veteran_requirements, generate_veteran_packet, audit_microtransaction, complete_tax_sandbox_order · Public sink: recheck_property_opportunities, find_va_forms, get_va_form, start_va_connection, disconnect_va_connection, audit_microtransaction, start_tax_sandbox, get_tax_sandbox_order, complete_tax_sandbox_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_property_assessment, get_owner_workspace, get_owner_review_details, review_veteran_requirements, generate_veteran_packet, start_tax_sandbox, get_tax_sandbox_order, complete_tax_sandbox_order · Private data: suggest_addresses, get_property_assessment, recheck_property_opportunities, get_va_facility, start_va_connection, disconnect_va_connection, review_veteran_requirements, generate_veteran_packet, audit_microtransaction, complete_tax_sandbox_order · Public sink: recheck_property_opportunities, find_va_forms, get_va_form, start_va_connection, disconnect_va_connection, audit_microtransaction, start_tax_sandbox, get_tax_sandbox_order, complete_tax_sandbox_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
